title: Decision: No PII in error responses
description: Why this is good: Error responses explicitly omit user IDs, peer addresses, and internal error detail strings. This prevents information leakage in logs and network traces. The code hardcodes opaque machine-readable types ('unauthorized', 'serverFail') instead of including debug info. The tests verify this is enforced (extractor_unknown_returns_401 and extractor_whois_fail_returns_500 both assert that sensitive values do not appear in response bodies). This pattern prevents a common security bug where error detail accidentally leaks PII to untrusted parties or to logs that may be exposed.
